# The AI For Series

> Practical AI books for internal auditors, finance teams, Chartered Accountants, tax practitioners and CA students: tested walkthroughs on practice files, answer keys, ready prompts and routines for keeping client and company data on your own computer. Written by Chandan Gupta. Sold as ebooks on Google Play Books and Amazon Kindle.

## Books
- [Which AI, Which Plan?](https://aiforseries.github.io/which-ai-which-plan/): How AI chat tools work, and how to choose one, in everyday analogies. Audience: Anyone who uses AI chat tools at work. 65 pages. Google Play (free).
- [AI for CAs](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-cas/): A practical guide to Claude Code for tax, audit, advisory and compliance work. Audience: Chartered Accountants in India. 162 pages. Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=zT8lEgAAQBAJ); Kindle (India) (https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0HQ4Q68D3); Kindle (US) (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ4Q68D3).
- [AI for Internal Auditors](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-internal-auditors/): A practical guide to Claude Code for risk-based audits, control testing, data analytics and reporting. Audience: Internal auditors, SOX and ICFR testers, audit managers and CAEs. 180 pages. Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=jIAmEgAAQBAJ); Kindle (India) (https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0HR9ZCCJ2); Kindle (US) (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HR9ZCCJ2).
- [Excel + AI for Finance Teams](https://aiforseries.github.io/excel-ai-for-finance/): Use Claude for Excel and Claude Code to clean, reconcile, model and report, and keep your spreadsheets auditable. Audience: Accountants, controllers, FP&A analysts and AP/AR teams. 156 pages. Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=soAmEgAAQBAJ); Kindle (India) (https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0HR9XC4TV); Kindle (US) (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HR9XC4TV).
- [AI for Tax Practitioners](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-tax-practitioners/): Run a faster, safer GST, ITR and bookkeeping practice with Claude Code. Audience: GST practitioners, income-tax consultants and small tax practices in India. 151 pages. Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=MoAmEgAAQBAJ); Kindle (India) (https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0HRVWPVL1); Kindle (US) (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HRVWPVL1).
- [AI for CA Students](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-ca-students/): Use Claude Code to study smarter for CA Foundation, Inter and Final, and shine in articleship, without cutting corners. Audience: CA Foundation, Inter and Final students and articled assistants. 119 pages. Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/books/details?id=XoAmEgAAQBAJ); Kindle (India) (https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0HRVMVTJQ); Kindle (US) (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HRVMVTJQ).

## What the books cover

### Which AI, Which Plan?
A short, plain-English guide to how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot actually work, and what free and paid plans really buy. Each idea gets one everyday analogy, one myth, and a two-minute experiment you can try. Free on Google Play.

- Is it really free? Yes. The ebook is free on Google Play Books worldwide.
- Do I need to be technical? No. Every idea is explained with an everyday analogy: a taxi meter for tokens, the size of a desk for the context window, a courier parcel for privacy.
- Does it recommend one AI tool? No. It explains how the tools work and gives five questions to ask of any new tool, so you can choose for your own work and budget.

### AI for CAs
For Chartered Accountants in India: income tax, GST, statutory and internal audit, reporting, advisory, compliance and forensic work. Three tested walkthroughs on practice files with answer keys, 109 ready prompts, and a routine that keeps client data on your laptop.

### AI for Internal Auditors
The whole internal audit lifecycle with Claude Code: risk assessment, planning, walkthroughs, control testing and sampling, full-population analytics, fraud red flags, working papers, observations, audit committee reporting and follow-up. Instead of pasting an AP extract into a chat window, the AI writes a small script that runs on your laptop against the full population, so only column headers and results leave your machine, and a reviewer can re-perform the test.

- Who is this book for? Internal auditors, SOX and ICFR testers, audit managers and chief audit executives who want to use AI on real engagements, not just for drafting emails.
- Do I need to know how to code? No. Claude Code writes and runs the scripts; the book shows you how to ask for them, read the result and check it against control totals.
- What about company data and confidentiality? Chapter 1 explains what an AI tool actually sends and what stays on your laptop. The method keeps the data local: the AI sees column headers and results, and the analysis runs on your machine.
- What do I need to follow along? A Windows or Mac laptop and a paid Claude plan, since Claude Code is not in the free plan. The book links to its practice files and answer keys.
- Is it affiliated with Anthropic or The IIA? No. It is an independent book, not endorsed by either.

### Excel + AI for Finance Teams
Claude for Excel and Claude Code on real finance work: cleaning ERP exports, bank and intercompany reconciliations, month-end close, budgets, forecasts and 13-week cash, auditing an inherited model, and management reporting packs. When to use the Excel add-in, when to use Claude Code, and how to keep every workbook auditable.

- Who is this book for? Accountants, controllers, FP&A analysts and AP/AR teams who live in Excel and want AI help they can check.
- Claude for Excel or Claude Code: which one? Chapter 4 compares them. The add-in works inside an open workbook; Claude Code works on files and folders and suits repeatable jobs such as a monthly bank reconciliation.
- Do I need to code or know Python? No. You describe the job, the AI writes the script, and the book shows how to check the output with tie-outs and control totals.
- What do I need to follow along? Excel on Windows or Mac and a paid Claude plan. The book links to its practice workbooks and answer keys.

### AI for Tax Practitioners
For the high-volume work of an Indian tax practice: GSTR-1 from sales registers, GSTR-2B and 3B checks across many clients, ITR season with AIS, 26AS and Form 16, TDS return data, Tally and bank statement clean-up, notice reply files, a compliance calendar and fee register, and client messages in English and Hindi.

- Who is this book for? GST practitioners, income-tax consultants, accountants and small tax offices in India that file for many clients.
- Will the AI file returns for me? No. It prepares and checks the working files; you review and file on the portal yourself. Chapter 13 covers checking the output and the limits.
- Is client data safe? Chapter 1 sets out a routine that keeps client files in the office: the AI writes scripts that run on your computer instead of reading every invoice.
- What do I need to follow along? A Windows or Mac computer and a paid Claude plan. The book links to its practice files and answer keys.

### AI for CA Students
AI as a tutor, not an answer machine. Study plans that survive a bad week, revision sheets and self-tests from your own notes, check-my-working practice, and mock-paper review. In articleship: vouching, ledger scrutiny, Excel and Tally clean-up, reconciliations and working papers, with the client's data kept safe.

- Is this a shortcut for exams? No. Every prompt keeps you doing the thinking: the AI checks your working, quizzes you and explains, rather than handing over answers.
- Does it help in articleship too? Yes. Part 3 covers vouching, ledger scrutiny, Excel and Tally exports, bank, 26AS/AIS and GSTR-2B reconciliations, and working papers.
- Do I need a paid plan? Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan. Chapter 2 shows what you can do on the free app and how to set up on a student budget.

## Free guides

- [Duplicate Payment Testing with AI: Full AP Population](https://aiforseries.github.io/guides/duplicate-payment-testing-with-ai.html): Test every AP invoice for duplicate payments and three-way match exceptions with AI, without uploading the ledger. Prompts, checks and limits.
- [Segregation of Duties Analysis with AI: User Access Review](https://aiforseries.github.io/guides/segregation-of-duties-analysis-with-ai.html): Find SoD conflicts, mitigated cases and leavers with active accounts across a full ERP access listing using AI, with user data kept on your laptop.
- [Journal Entry Testing with AI: Completeness and Risk Scoring](https://aiforseries.github.io/guides/journal-entry-testing-with-ai.html): Roll the trial balance forward, score every manual journal against criteria you can defend, and keep GL data on your laptop. Prompts and checks.
- [Bank Reconciliation with AI: A Month-End Method](https://aiforseries.github.io/guides/bank-reconciliation-with-ai.html): Use Claude Code to write a bank reconciliation script that runs on your own computer, ties both balances to zero and lists every exception for review.
- [Claude for Excel vs Claude Code for Finance Teams](https://aiforseries.github.io/guides/claude-for-excel-vs-claude-code.html): When to use the Claude for Excel add-in and when to use Claude Code for finance work: what each does, what each sends, and a job-by-job rule.
- [Audit an Inherited Excel Model with AI: A Review Method](https://aiforseries.github.io/guides/auditing-an-inherited-excel-model-with-ai.html): Review a forecast model you didn't build: use Claude Code to list hardcodes, broken links, hidden sheets and unit errors by cell, without editing it.

## Free tools

- [Form 3CD to Form No. 26 crosswalk](https://aiforseries.github.io/tools/form-3cd-to-form-26-crosswalk.html): every Form 3CD clause mapped to Form No. 26 (Income-tax Act 2025, s.63, rule 47), with the change type and data needed; CSV at https://aiforseries.github.io/tools/form-3cd-to-form-26-crosswalk.csv
- [Free GSTR-2B Reconciliation Tool (Runs in Your Browser)](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-cas/tools/gstr2b-reconciler.html): Reconcile GSTR-2B with your purchase register free, in your browser: nothing is uploaded. Matches on GSTIN and invoice number, ties control totals and builds the ITC bridge.
- [AI Use Policy Template for CA Firms in India](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-cas/tools/ca-firm-ai-policy-template.html): A free AI use policy template for Indian CA firms: what client data may be shared, consent, review, documentation, an engagement letter clause and an acknowledgement form.

## Bhasad & Associates (comedy series prompt pages)

- [Bhasad & Associates: all episodes](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/): a claymation comedy about using AI at work, set in a fictional CA firm and its client company. Each episode page gives the habit and one free, copy-ready prompt, with what to give the AI and what to check.
- [Episode 1: Section 420½ (check every citation)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep1/): Ask for every section with its source, then check the source yourself.
- [Episode 2: Chat se hisaab (the formula from AI, the total from Excel)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep2/): Get the formula from the AI; get the total from Excel.
- [Episode 3: Purana Act, naya zamana (tax year first, then the Act, then the section)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep3/): Check the tax year first, then the Act, then the section.
- [Episode 4: Audit kar do (brief the AI like a junior)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep4/): Give a scoped brief: match the big bank payments to the voucher register; the unmatched ones go into Excel.
- [Episode 5: AI ne bola (the AI didn't see your facts)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep5/): The AI's answer isn't final: check the source and the facts, both.
- [Episode 6: Ek client, sau client (the work scales; the review doesn't vanish)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep6/): Test on one, run the batch, check rows and totals for every client, review the exceptions. The sign-off stays yours.
- [Episode 7: Saaf kar do (never the originals: backup first, copies only)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep7/): Never the originals: take a backup, then work only on copies.
- [Episode 8: Shortcut (a checker, not a solver)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep8/): Ask the AI to quiz you and catch your mistakes, not to solve for you.
- [Episode 9: Sab fraud hai (judgement stays with you)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep9/): The script finds exceptions; we make the findings.
- [Episode 10: Difference zero (match the count and the totals first)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep10/): Match the count and the totals first: as much in as out, before you trust the difference.
- [Episode 11: Poora ledger (keep company data out of the chat)](https://aiforseries.github.io/clay/ep11/): Only the column headings go to the AI; run the script on your own laptop.

## Gyaani's Desk (hands-on tools, run in the browser)
- [Gyaani's Desk](https://aiforseries.github.io/lab/): five one-minute tools for finance work: brief an AI like a junior, check what is safe to paste, match counts and totals, write a safe brief for an AI agent, and spot Gyaani's mistake. Nothing typed leaves the browser.
- [Brief Gyaani](https://aiforseries.github.io/lab/brief/): pick a finance task (bank reco, ledger scrutiny, GSTR-2B match, TDS check, vouching sample, AR ageing, notice citations, exam study, duplicate payments, bank narrations) and score a brief to an AI on six visible checks: the task, the data and where it is (headings only), the rule, the output, the checks, and safety and judgement. Includes a strong example brief for each task.
- [Agent brief builder](https://aiforseries.github.io/lab/agent/): pick a job for an AI agent working on files and switch on eight guardrails (copies, backup, never delete or overwrite originals, plan first, change log, stop on errors, counts and totals, deletions as a list only) to get a copyable, tool-neutral brief.
- [Safe to paste?](https://aiforseries.github.io/lab/safe-paste/): paste a ledger, bank statement or email, or drop a CSV, and see the PANs, GSTINs, Aadhaar-like and account numbers, IFSCs, emails, phone numbers, names, amounts and dates an AI chat would get. Gives a masked copy with consistent tokens (PARTY_01, PAN_01) and the safe alternative: only the column headings, with a ready prompt for a script that runs on your own computer. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [Jitna andar, utna bahar (count check)](https://aiforseries.github.io/lab/count-check/): drop a source export (for example a bank statement) and an AI's result (for example its reconciliation) to compare rows in vs rows out, totals in vs out, the difference, duplicates, rows missing from the result, and blank, heading or subtotal rows that inflate counts. Reads Indian number formats, Dr/Cr and Withdrawal/Deposit columns. Includes a prompt for a script that prints these control totals. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.
